Tamil Nadu government releases list of public holidays for 2027
 Updated - October 22, 2026 05:56 pm IST - CHENNAI 
 The Hindu Bureau READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 Image used for representation
 | Photo Credit: B. Jothi Ramalingam
 The Tamil Nadu government has announced the list of public holidays for 2027. Here is the full list:
 Full list of holidays - 2027
 New Year’s Day on January 1 (Friday) Pongal on January 15 (Friday) Thiruvalluvar Day on January 16 (Saturday) Uzhavar Thirunal on January 17 (Sunday) Thaipusam on January 22 (Friday) Republic Day on January 26 (Tuesday) Eid ul-Fitr on March 10 (Wednesday) Good Friday on March 26 (Friday) Telugu New Year on April 7 (Wednesday) Dr. Ambedkar’s Birthday / Tamil New Year’s Day on April 14 (Wednesday) Mahavir Jayanti on April 19 (Monday) May Day on May 1 (Saturday) Bakrid on May 17 (Monday) Muharram on June 15 (Tuesday) Independence Day / Milad-un-Nabi on August 15 (Sunday) Krishna Jayanti on August 25 (Wednesday) Ganesh Chaturthi on September 4 (Saturday) Gandhi Jayanti on October 2 (Saturday) Ayudha Poojai on October 8 (Friday) Vijayadasami on October 9 (Saturday) Deepavali on October 28 (Thursday) Christmas on December 25 (Saturday) 
 Annual closing of accounts for commercial and cooperative banks (April 1) will be a holiday applicable only to commercial and cooperative banks in Tamil Nadu.
